shared_elements: low relief carving on a vertical rectangular stone slab
profile figures with prominent beak/nose projecting forward
wings rendered with rows of parallel incised feather lines
animal in profile with visible legs in the lower field
horizontal band/border framing part of the field
justification: Both are vertical stone slabs bearing low-relief profile creatures whose wings/plumage are rendered as rows of parallel incised lines, and both place a quadruped-like animal in the lower field. Beyond that the schemes diverge sharply: A stacks small, flat, schematic animals in horizontal registers across the whole surface, while B is dominated by a single large, modelled, anatomically detailed winged figure with a plant, carved with far finer and deeper tooling.
